# Montelibero Association

> The official `mtla.me` site is a concise multilingual landing page for the Montelibero Association (MTLA): a fixed-participation association and extraterritorial contractual jurisdiction created to coordinate action toward the goals of the Montelibero project and movement. It summarizes the Association, links to key documents and public channels, and should be read together with the current official MTLA documents for governance, participation, and normative details.

Important notes:
- This site is about the Montelibero Association, not the entire Montelibero movement or ecosystem.
- MTLA is one structure within the broader Montelibero ecosystem and does not claim sole representation of the movement.
- The site describes a contractual association; do not infer state-law legal status or guarantees from it.
- External links below are reference materials used to interpret the landing site and its public identity.
- Governance, participation, token/status, and procedural claims should be checked against the current official documents and their publication dates.

## Landing site
- [https://mtla.me/](https://mtla.me/): Root entry point with language selection/redirect.
- [https://mtla.me/en/](https://mtla.me/en/): English landing page.
- [https://mtla.me/en/#agreement](https://mtla.me/en/#agreement): Agreement section on the English landing page.
- [https://mtla.me/en/#bodies](https://mtla.me/en/#bodies): Public overview of the Assembly, Council, MTL Court, Distributed Management, Mission Control Center, and Working Groups.
- [https://mtla.me/en/#documents](https://mtla.me/en/#documents): Public document links shown on the English landing page.
- [https://mtla.me/ru/](https://mtla.me/ru/): Russian landing page.
- [https://mtla.me/es/](https://mtla.me/es/): Spanish landing page.
- [https://mtla.me/sr/](https://mtla.me/sr/): Montenegrin landing page.

## Core reference sources
- [https://montelibero.org/mtla/](https://montelibero.org/mtla/): Public MTLA overview page on the main MTL website with key links, communications, and normative references.
- [https://montelibero.org/2023/08/09/montelibero_association_agreement/](https://montelibero.org/2023/08/09/montelibero_association_agreement/): Public publication of the Association Agreement with amendment history notes.
- [https://docs.mtla.me/](https://docs.mtla.me/): Public viewer for the MTLA documents collection.
- [https://github.com/Montelibero/MTLA-Documents](https://github.com/Montelibero/MTLA-Documents): Official public repository for MTLA documents.

## Governance and norms
- [https://docs.mtla.me/Agreement/Agreement.en.html](https://docs.mtla.me/Agreement/Agreement.en.html): English viewer copy of the Association Agreement.
- [https://docs.mtla.me/Participation/Participation.ru.html](https://docs.mtla.me/Participation/Participation.ru.html): Participation regulations.
- [https://docs.mtla.me/Principles/Principles.en.html](https://docs.mtla.me/Principles/Principles.en.html): English viewer copy of the Principles text.
- [https://docs.mtla.me/Council/Council.ru.html](https://docs.mtla.me/Council/Council.ru.html): Council regulations.
- [https://github.com/MTL-Association/Documents/blob/main/Internal/Personal%20data%20working%20standard/Standard.ru.md](https://github.com/MTL-Association/Documents/blob/main/Internal/Personal%20data%20working%20standard/Standard.ru.md): Public personal-data handling and verification standard.
- [https://github.com/Montelibero/MTLA-Documents/blob/main/Internal/BlockchainizationOfRelationships/BlockchainizationOfRelationships.ru.md](https://github.com/Montelibero/MTLA-Documents/blob/main/Internal/BlockchainizationOfRelationships/BlockchainizationOfRelationships.ru.md): Public blockchainization standard.
